ORDER BY r.rcmd_id,r.rank_ord) r ORDER BY
r.rcmd_id r.rcmd_type_cd coalesce(r.proj_id,r.opp_id) r.job_cd r.bgn_ym r.req_grade_cd r.reg_dttm r.reg_user_id "candidateCount" r.rcmd_id

SELECT 'OPPORTUNITY' AS "targetType",opp_id AS "targetId",opp_nm AS name,ctrt_type_cd AS "contractTypeCode", proj_id AS "projectIdAfterWin",NULL::date AS "contractStartDate",NULL::date AS "contractEndDate", substring(bgn_plan_ym,1,4)||'-'||substring(bgn_plan_ym,5,2) AS "startMonth" FROM tb_sl_opp WHERE opp_stat_cd='ING' UNION ALL SELECT 'PROJECT',proj_id,proj_nm,ctrt_type_cd,NULL::varchar,ctrt_bgn_dt,ctrt_end_dt,to_char(ctrt_bgn_dt,'YYYY-MM') FROM tb_pj_proj WHERE proj_stat_cd='ING' AND ctrt_type_cd <> 'IN' AND ctrt_end_dt >= #{today} ORDER BY "targetType",name,"targetId"

SELECT n.need_sn::text AS "needSn",n.job_cd AS "jobCode",n.grade_cd AS "gradeCode",n.need_cnt::int AS "needCount", substring(n.bgn_ym,1,4)||'-'||substring(n.bgn_ym,5,2) AS "startMonth",n.prd_mcnt::int AS "periodMonths", n.mon_mm::text AS "monthlyMm",(SELECT count(*)::int FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn t WHERE t.opp_id=n.opp_id AND t.need_sn=n.need_sn AND t.tent_stat_cd='ACT') AS "activeCount", jsonb_build_object('need',to_jsonb(n),'tentatives',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.tent_id) FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn t WHERE t.opp_id=n.opp_id AND t.need_sn=n.need_sn))::text AS snapshot FROM tb_sl_opp_need n WHERE n.opp_id=#{id} ORDER BY n.need_sn
SELECT p.job_cd FROM tb_pj_mnpw_plan p LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code c ON c.code_grp_id='JOB' AND c.code=p.job_cd WHERE p.proj_id=#{id} ORDER BY c.sort_ord NULLS LAST,p.job_cd LIMIT 1
SELECT c.code FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id WHERE c.code_grp_id='JOB' AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY c.sort_ord,c.code LIMIT 1
SELECT lpad(trunc(std_val)::text,6,'0') FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM' ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT jsonb_build_object('project',(SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM tb_pj_proj p WHERE p.proj_id=#{id}), 'plans',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.job_cd) FROM tb_pj_mnpw_plan p WHERE p.proj_id=#{id}), 'codes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY c.code_grp_id,c.code) FROM tb_sy_code c), 'standards',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY s.std_cd,s.aply_bgn_ym) FROM tb_sy_oper_std s))::text
